name: Brattleboro Music Center Summer Programs
description_short: A community music school in Brattleboro, VT, that runs Step it Down, a one-week morning camp of songs, dances, folktales and singing games for children ages 6 to 12. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

sources.note: Ages, activities and one-week morning format are for the Step it Down children's camp; 2027 dates TBA

warnings: The 2026 season is over and 2027 programs are not posted yet: 'Our programs for summer of 2027 will be listed as they are known.' All 2027 dates are TBA.

Age 6-12 applies only to the Step it Down children's camp. String Orchestra Reads is a weekly drop-in for intermediate to advanced string players 'high school and up' (adults included), paid 'by donation per session'. In 2026 it met Tuesday evenings 5:30-7:00 p.m. from August 11.
The page is the music center's general summer programs page, not a page for a single dedicated camp.
